resources.string: Speak English confidently with AI. Practice scenario calls and receive feedback after each call.
Unable to sign in. Please try again.
Talk with AI to estimate your communication skills and find a suitable learning path. The number of tasks depends on your results; each task is a separate call.
Assessment calls have no transcript or dictionary tools and are not saved to History.
This estimate supports learning; it is not a certificate.
This estimate supports learning; it is not a certificate.
Changes have not been saved. Please try again.
You will start on the A1 path, the lowest level supported. Your confirmation task did not meet all requirements. This is an estimated learning level.
You met this criterion in the confirmation task.
Keep practicing this criterion based on your confirmation task.
Resume from the saved step or start over. An unfinished task may need to be repeated.
There is not enough evidence to determine your level. You can start again when ready.
The call ended after 5 minutes. Only valid recorded evidence is used for assessment; processing does not extend the call duration.
Processing your responses. Please stay connected and wait a moment.
The current task is not enough to confirm your level. Continue to the next assessment step.
Audio or connectivity was unstable. Retry this task; your current level is unchanged.
The last task was not enough to confirm your speaking level.
Unlocks after all units are complete
Check your connection and try again.
Check your connection and try again. Your learning progress is unchanged.
Loading the scenario and learning materials.
The lesson materials or scenario are incomplete. Check the content and try again.
You can start roleplay at any time. Speak naturally; you do not need to memorize the examples.
If audio is unavailable, you can still read the pronunciation and examples.
You may use different wording as long as you communicate clearly and complete the task.
These sentences are suggestions. Focus on effective communication, not memorization.
Connection lost. SpeakMate is trying to reconnect. You can still end the call.
The microphone is temporarily unavailable. Check recording permission or other apps using it, then try resuming before this session expires.
A session containing your speech will be assessed and saved. If you have not spoken, it will not be saved.
Your connection is unstable. Check it and try again.
This debug build has no Gemini configuration. Configure access and rebuild the debug app.
Gemini denied access. Check the credentials and permissions for the test project.
The test project has reached its Gemini quota. Check the quota before retrying.
The Gemini Live model is unavailable for the test project.
The session waited too long for Gemini or the audio device. Please try again.
SpeakMate could not read the Gemini response. Please try again.
SpeakMate needs microphone permission to start or resume a call.
SpeakMate cannot continue recording or playing audio. Check your device and try again.
Response audio is arriving faster than it can play. Please start another call.
The pause period has expired. Call again to start a new session.
A session interrupted by a connection failure is not saved.
SpeakMate needs the microphone to send your speech to Gemini and maintain the voice conversation.
You can mute the microphone during a call.
Open Settings to allow SpeakMate to use the microphone, then return and check permission.
Unable to open microphone permissions. Allow access in your device Settings, then check again.
Microphone permission was revoked. SpeakMate stopped recording. Grant permission in Settings before calling again.
Long-press a word to look it up. The call continues.
No suitable meaning was found for this word.
Unable to look up this word. Check your connection and try again.
This word has insufficient information to save to Vocabulary.
This word was already saved and has moved to the top.
The oldest saved word was removed to make room for this word
Unable to save this word. Please try again.
Unit complete. Continue your path to the next learning activity.
There is not enough evidence for a reliable assessment. This is not a failed result; your level and progress are unchanged.
The valid completed session is saved to History without an assessment result. Check your microphone and speak clearly when retrying.
Your progress is unchanged. Pass this unit to unlock the next activity.
Processing your speaking session. Results will appear here; your progress has not changed.
Range · Accuracy · Fluency · Interaction · Coherence. Pass: 4–5 criteria; partial: 3; not passed: 0–2.
All required actions must be completed. Partial, failed or insufficient-evidence results leave progress unchanged.
You passed at least 4/5 speaking criteria and completed the required actions.
You passed the final goal. Your learning path is complete.
You passed 3/5 speaking criteria and completed the required actions.
The number of passed speaking criteria is below the requirement: 0 to 2 out of 5.
A required communication action is incomplete, so this task is not passed regardless of the speaking criteria.
The session is complete, but there is not enough evidence for a reliable assessment. This is not a failed result.
You met the requirements in this practice attempt. The session result is saved to History.
B2 is the highest level currently supported. You can repeat units, goal assessments or free practice.
Free practice does not change your level or learning progress.
The list loaded, but no scenarios are available to start. Retry loading or return to your learning path.
Scenarios are not ready yet. Come back later or continue learning on your path.
Check your connection and retry loading. You can still return to your learning path.
This session is saved to History. Free practice does not change your level or progress.
Complete a practice session to review its duration, available result and conversation.
Check your connection and retry loading. Saved sessions will appear after loading succeeds.
Check your connection and try again. Session information and transcript have not loaded.
Session information and results are loaded. Retry loading to view the conversation.
View, search and manage your saved words.
Unable to sign out. Please try again.
You will return to Google sign-in. Progress and vocabulary saved on the server are kept.
Your current progress does not match the learning path. Retry loading.
Complete the assessment to unlock the next goal.
This unit is not unlocked in your current progress.
Not synced. Your result is not saved on the server; you can retry saving it.
The result of this session is unavailable. Unsaved sessions may be lost if the app process ends. Saved sessions remain in History. You can return to the lesson or your learning path.
You passed %1$d/5 criteria, but a required communication action is incomplete.
You passed %1$d/5 criteria. See the detailed assessment below.
There is not enough evidence to assess this criterion.
This goal assessment is not unlocked yet.
%1$s\n\nThe assessment call has no transcript or dictionary tools.
You completed all goals in the %1$s path. Your current speaking level is still %1$s.
You can assess for %1$s or practice completed content again. Completing a path does not automatically raise your level.
Your %1$s path is complete. Talk with AI to assess readiness for %2$s. Each task is a separate call, with no transcript or dictionary tools, and is not saved to History.
Only passing %2$s confirmation updates your level and skill profile. Without confirmation, your %1$s level and progress are unchanged.
You passed confirmation at the next level. Your profile is awaiting save confirmation; the new path opens only after saving succeeds.
Your %2$s level and speaking skill profile are updated. Your new path starts at Goal 1 → Unit 1. This assessment is not saved to History.
%2$s was not confirmed. Your %1$s level and current progress are unchanged, with no downgrade. This assessment has ended and is not saved to History.
There is not enough evidence to conclude this step. Your %1$s level and progress are unchanged. Check your microphone and connection, then retry the same step.
You used all %3$d retries for this step. This assessment has ended; your level and progress are unchanged. You can start a new assessment from the path completion screen.
Only A1, A2 or B1 learners with a completed path can assess for promotion. B2 is the highest level currently supported.
Not synced. You can retry saving this session.
You have not completed a level assessment yet.
An estimate for learning, not a certificate.
Your previous call ended because microphone permission was revoked or the app was closed. That session was not saved to History.
Unable to load saved vocabulary. Please try again.
Deletion is not confirmed. The latest available list is shown; retry deletion if the word is still there.
Check your connection and retry. Your profile must be ready before you can open the learning path.
You are offline. Check your connection and try again.
Sign-in cancelled. You can try again when ready.
This content is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
Your level is not assessed yet
Complete the initial assessment to open a suitable learning path.
Call in any scenario without affecting your learning path progress.
SpeakMate estimates your Speaking Level from an assessment to guide practice; it is not a certificate. Completing a path does not automatically confirm the next level.
Data is not up to date
You can still view the loaded path. Your latest progress must be verified before starting.
This goal is not fully configured to start. You can return to your learning path.
You can preview this lesson. Complete the current activity and the preceding goal assessment to unlock the next activity. Locked lessons cannot be started yet.
Unable to load your profile or progress. Please retry before starting.
Complete units and goal assessments; promotion requires reassessment.
Check your connection and retry assessment.
A technical error prevented assessment. You can retry using the original recording while it is valid. The result and progress are not finalized. Unsaved sessions may be lost if the app process ends.
The assessed result is awaiting saving. Progress changes only after saving succeeds.
This session’s unsaved recording and result will be deleted. Sessions already saved on the server are unaffected.
This assessment expired. Start again; expired evidence does not change your current level.
Not synced: your account cannot save this session. Automatic retries stopped; the session remains on this device until its remaining deadline.
Not synced: server data does not match this session. Saving stopped to avoid overwriting it. The session remains on this device until its remaining deadline.
Not synced: session data is invalid for saving. Automatic retries stopped. The session remains on this device until its remaining deadline.
Microphone stopped. Finalizing the conversation before changing screens.
Unable to receive the completed session. Retry finalizing; you do not need a new call.
You have not spoken in this session. Ending now will not create a practice result.
After finalizing, the conversation will enter the save process. You can track its status on the summary screen.
End the current task and process the result within the assessment flow.
No conversation yet. Content will appear when transcription is received.
Unable to load this session. Unsaved sessions are kept only while the app process is running. Saved sessions remain in History.
The conversation is being saved. You can view the temporary copy or leave this screen while waiting.
Not synced · Temporary transcript on this device
Unable to update content. The displayed data is kept; it must be checked again before starting.
This lesson has no preparation vocabulary yet. You can still start if the call content is valid.
This lesson has no preparation grammar yet. You can still start if the call content is valid.
This lesson has no preparation patterns yet. You can still start if the call content is valid.
The recording is unavailable or expired. This session is not assessed; it is not a failed result and does not advance progress.
You chose to keep this session without assessment. This is not a failed result; progress is unchanged.
The result is assessed but not synced. Progress changes only after saving succeeds.
The result is saved, but progress could not be refreshed. You can still read the full result; retry updating before continuing.
This scenario is no longer available. Return to the list and choose another scenario.
This is a repeat practice attempt. Progress already made is kept.
No sessions match the current filter. Try clearing the filter.
Unable to update history. Previously loaded sessions are kept.
This session was not found in the current account’s history.
You cannot access this session. Return to History to check your account.
Result saved · Showing a temporary copy on this device
Unable to reread the saved copy. The displayed content is kept; you can retry loading.
The temporary copy is not ready. You can return to History while processing continues.
No complete transcript was saved for this session.
Variety and suitability of vocabulary and structures.
Accuracy of grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation.
Ability to maintain relatively continuous speech.
Ability to understand, respond and maintain conversation turns.
Ability to organize and connect ideas clearly.
Unable to update your profile. Showing the most recently loaded data.
Some unsaved sessions could not be identified. Signing out discards pending data on this device; you can cancel and check History first.
Unable to update vocabulary. Showing the most recently loaded list.
No matching words. Try another word or clear your search.
Tap a word in the call transcript to look up its meaning and save it here.
A higher-level task will help confirm a suitable level. Each task is a separate call; your level is unchanged.
A lower-level task will help find a suitable starting level. This is not a level decision yet; each task is a separate call.
You used all %1$d retries for this task. This assessment has ended; your current level and progress are unchanged.
There is no suitable assessment content to continue. Missing data cannot confirm or change your level.
The valid-task limit was reached without confirming a level. This assessment has ended; your current level is unchanged.
Unable to load your profile or assessment content. Retry loading; your level and progress are unchanged.
No speech was recorded from you. Check your microphone and repeat this task. This is not a failed result; your level and progress are unchanged.
There is not enough speech for a reliable assessment. Give fuller answers when repeating this task; your level and progress are unchanged.
The recording is missing, corrupted or unavailable. Repeat this task; invalid data is not used to determine your level.
There is not enough valid transcript to assess this task. Repeat it; your level and progress are unchanged.
The call was interrupted and cannot be assessed reliably. Check your connection and repeat this task; your level and progress are unchanged.
Your result is ready and awaiting save confirmation. The %1$s path is available only after server confirmation.
B2 is the highest level SpeakMate supports. Repeat lessons, goal assessments or free practice; there is no promotion to C1.
You do not have a confirmed speaking level yet. Complete the initial assessment before assessing for promotion.
Complete your current path before assessing for promotion. Your level and progress are unchanged.
The assessment state is no longer valid to continue. Your level and progress are unchanged; you can start a new assessment from your path.
Noise can make your speech harder to hear
The app will request permission when you start
Speak naturally; perfection is not required
Fuller answers help make assessment more reliable
Each task is a separate call
Checking your profile and lesson content with the server. You can go back while waiting.
Language applies to the interface. Scenario content, Vietnamese meanings and AI feedback keep their original language when no translation is available. Practice calls are always in English.
Unable to load your language preference. Please retry loading.
Unable to save this language. Your previous choice is kept; select again to retry saving.
